title: A Multi-Domain Study on the Effectiveness of LLMs at Writing Property-Based Tests
abstract: arXiv:2610.34487v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A property-based test (PBT) checks a property of a program on many generated inputs, but writing one takes a property, a generator of valid inputs, and an oracle. LLM-based PBT writers produce all three, yet they have been evaluated only on Python libraries. We study how two of them, Proptest-AI and Agentic-PBT, generalize to ten programs in five domains: deep learning libraries, databases, system software, compilers, and LLM serving engines. Most of these programs take text in their own language, such as queries, configurations, and programs. Agentic-PBT covers more branches than Proptest-AI on seven of the ten programs with Opus 5 and on all ten with GLM-5.3-Flash. Domain-specific fuzzers cover more of the compilers and of PostgreSQL and less of PyTorch than Agentic-PBT. We filed 180 bug reports, 44 of which duplicate reports that others filed after the models' knowledge cutoffs; maintainers have confirmed 65 of the others, in all five

translated_title: 关于大语言模型编写基于属性测试有效性的多领域研究
translated_abstract: 基于属性的测试（PBT）通过在大量生成的输入上检查程序的某个属性来验证程序，但编写这样的测试需要定义一个属性、一个有效输入生成器和一个预言机。基于大语言模型的PBT编写工具能够自动生成这三者，但此前仅在Python库上被评估过。我们研究了其中两个工具——Proptest-AI和Agentic-PBT——如何泛化到五个领域的十个程序上：深度学习库、数据库、系统软件、编译器和LLM服务引擎。这些程序大多接受其自身语言形式的文本输入，例如查询、配置文件和程序代码。在使用Opus 5模型时，Agentic-PBT在十个程序中的七个上比Proptest-AI覆盖了更多分支；在使用GLM-5.3-Flash时，Agentic-PBT在全部十个程序上均覆盖更多分支。领域专用的模糊测试工具在编译器和PostgreSQL上的覆盖率高于Agentic-PBT，而在PyTorch上的覆盖率则低于它。我们共提交了180份错误报告，其中44份与模型知识截止日期之后他人提交的报告重复；其余报告中有65份已获维护者确认，且覆盖了全部五个领域。
tldr: 该研究首次将基于LLM的属性测试编写工具从Python库扩展评估到深度学习、数据库、系统软件、编译器和LLM服务五个领域的十个程序，发现Agentic-PBT的分支覆盖表现更优、可与领域专用模糊测试工具相媲美，并通过180份错误报告（65份已获确认）证明了其跨领域发现真实缺陷的能力。
en_tdlr: This multi-domain study shows that LLM-based property-based test writers, especially Agentic-PBT, generalize beyond Python libraries to programs across five domains, achieving competitive branch coverage over domain-specific fuzzers and yielding 180 bug reports with 65 confirmed by maintainers.
